summary: JDE Peet's is dutch beverage company, founded in 2015. Type: listed company. About 10,532 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 4 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions; 1 about growth or hiring.

culture.text: Coffee and tea company with brands such as Douwe Egberts, Peet's, L'OR and Jacobs, present in over 100 markets.
Staff often come from Wageningen, Groningen and University of Amsterdam, mostly in business, marketing and economics.

open.text: JDE Peet's N.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Had €9.9 billion sales and more than 21,000 employees worldwide in 2025.

worth_knowing.text: Keurig Dr Pepper completed its buyout of JDE Peet's at €31.85 a share, so it is now part of a US group.
Union CNV reached an agreement with JDE Peet's on an early-retirement scheme.
Its coffee factory in Banbury, UK is closing.
